profile.birth.hint: The year is enough. With the full date your age is exact to the day.
profile.invalidUnits: Check your input: height {heightMin} to {heightMax} {heightUnit}, weight {weightMin} to {weightMax} {weightUnit}, steps goal 1,000 to 50,000, a real birth date that is not in the future, maximum heart rate 120 to 230 and resting heart rate 30 to 120, below the maximum.
profile.zones.title: Heart-rate zones
profile.zones.sources: Leave a field empty to use the value OpenHoop works out: maximum {max} bpm ({maxSource}), resting {rest} bpm ({restSource}). Both set your zones and your load.
profile.zones.max.fallback: a default until you add your birth year
profile.zones.rest.fallback: a default until nights are measured
profile.zones.noteAuto: Auto zones use heart-rate reserve (HRR): 40, 60, 70, 80 and 90% of the way from your resting to your maximum heart rate.
profile.zones.noteCustom: Enter the lowest heart rate of each zone. Your zones count for activities, days and the live screen; past days are counted again when you save.
profile.zones.invalid: Each zone must start higher than the one below it, between 40 and 230 bpm, and zone 5 must start below your maximum heart rate.
plan.setup.pick: Pick up to three goals. The difficulty sets the targets, and you can fine-tune each one below.
plan.goal.loadDays.title: Load days

plan.goal.sleepScore.title: Sleep score
plan.goal.strength.title: Strength time

plan.setup.full: You picked {max} goals. Turn one off to pick another.
plan.setup.levelNote: Easy, Balanced and Hard set every target at once. Steps follow your daily steps goal when you have one.
plan.setup.fineTuned: You fine-tuned some targets. Picking a difficulty sets them all again.

plan.setup.scoreMinHint: The lowest score that counts for a night
plan.setup.strengthHint: Strength sessions and strength activities this week
plan.setup.stepsHint: Your daily average over the week
plan.setup.noGoals: Turn on at least one goal to save a plan.
plan.left.allDone: Every goal is reached for this week. Anything more is a bonus.
plan.left.behind.loadDays: Load days are out of reach this week. Lower the target or keep going for the habit.
plan.left.behind.sleepScore: The sleep goal is out of reach this week. Lower the target or keep going for the habit.
plan.left.behind.strength: Strength time is out of reach this week. Lower the target or keep going for the habit.
plan.left.behind.steps: The steps average is out of reach this week. Lower the target or keep going for the habit.
plan.left.loadDays.one: One more day with a load of {threshold} or more.
plan.left.loadDays.other: {count} more days with a load of {threshold} or more.
plan.left.sleepScore.one: One more night with a sleep score of {min}% or more.
plan.left.sleepScore.other: {count} more nights with a sleep score of {min}% or more.
plan.left.steps: About {steps} steps a day from now on to reach your average.
plan.left.todayHigh: Your readiness is high today, so today suits a load day.
plan.left.todayLow: Your readiness is low today. Keep today light and use the days after.
plan.left.lastDay: Today is the last day of this plan week.
plan.noGoals.title: No goals in this plan
plan.noGoals.body: Turn on at least one goal to follow your week.
plan.detail.sleepScore: A night counts when its sleep score is {min}% or more. Nights measured so far: {measured}.
plan.detail.strength: Strength sessions and strength activities count. Where they overlap, the time counts once.
plan.detail.steps: Band steps count, or imported steps on days the band has none. The goal is your average over the week.
plan.verdict.balanced: Well balanced: your load fitted your readiness every day.
plan.verdict.room: Well rested, with room for more load.
plan.verdict.moreLoad: More load than the week before.
plan.verdict.lessLoad: Less load than the week before.
plan.share.title: Share this report
plan.share.subtitle: An image of the card below. Nothing leaves your phone until you pick an app.
plan.share.error: The image could not be made. Try again.
plan.share.privacy: Only these numbers are in the image. Your name, birth date and location are never added.
plan.chart.noBalance: No days with both readiness and load yet.
plan.chart.balanceNoBand: The shaded zone appears once there are enough days to know your usual load.
